name: 46814 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46814 (Fort Wayne) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46814 (Fort Wayne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46814 (Fort Wayne) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46814 (Fort Wayne) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
